protocol.scope: RQ3 validation-set session-mix ablation; no protected final-test inputs
protocol.target: Signed finite-difference acceleration (m/s2), conditioned on observed midpoint speed
protocol.features: Reuse effective power equation m*v*a=P-k*v^3. Fit each development event and exact DRS separately; session mix is the deliberate within-event intervention. No cross-car or cross-event coefficient pooling.
protocol.preprocessing: Unchanged prepared conditional-motion candidates, throttle>=95%, no brake, unchanged known gear/DRS, positive speed, pair gap<=0.5 s. Do not interpolate or count adjacent windows as independent.
protocol.fitting: Existing f1energy.identification.fit_effective bounded least squares: 0.1-1.2 MW, drag 0-3 kg/m. Require qualifying source at least 2 unique laps and 30 windows per event/DRS. No parameter tuning.
protocol.arm_definition: Q=qualifying; P=all Practice sessions; R=Race. Full-volume arms use all eligible development rows. Each matched arm uses exactly its event/DRS Q row count, allocated as equally as available across Q/P or Q/P/R; shuffle rows without replacement using seeds 0..4. Q arm is identical across seeds. Window-volume matching does not match unique lap counts or speed distributions.
protocol.transfer: Median conditional acceleration predictions across eligible development event fits with identical exact DRS; no session matching, as the question is session-pool transfer. All arms share same development event/DRS support and same validation rows.
protocol.validation: Hungary and UK only; no fitting on validation. Each event/session/driver/lap/DRS group RMSE then equal group mean per event; event mean has equal event weights. Report per-session metrics and speed extrapolation. Constant baseline is median eligible Q training means.
protocol.sensitivity_definition: Reapply declared filter to development and validation before fitting, without selection on errors. Report all outcomes, exclusions, parameter boundaries and conditions.
protocol.acceptance: Descriptive support for QPR benefit only if QPR and every QPR_matched seed improve event macro RMSE relative to Q in both validation events in all three sensitivities. Otherwise no consistent session-mix improvement established. This is not significance or causal identification.
protocol.protected_test_decision: Do not open Belgium/Abu Dhabi. Validation-only roadmap stage; source qualification coverage is sparse and this new intervention requires sensitivity assessment. Final inverse heldout fitting remains a separate future protocol.
protocol.limitations: Previously inspected validation, conditional speed supplied, two events and one driver, sparse qualifying support and unknown effective fuel/setup/grade/electrical split. Effective coefficients are not battery or true vehicle parameters. No free-running lap or real electrical deployment accuracy.
